description: The new scoring loop does not preserve the native evaluator's tighter temporary lifetimes.
trigger: Score at least two rows successfully, so that an earlier row has left a `log_probs` tensor bound when the next forward starts.
expected_behavior: Release the completed row's log-probability reference before cache cleanup and the next forward, as `eval/ppl.py` does.
actual_behavior: The reference survives the cache-cleanup call and remains bound through the next forward until the next `log_softmax` result is assigned. Separately, `.float() + 1e-10` is an out-of-place addition rather than the parent's `+=`, so it can require another full scoring-sized tensor during the addition.

verification.description: Compared the assignments and deletions across both row loops. The task diff reaches the new loop through its own CLI; the parent search found no reference to the new script.
verification.limits: The reference lifetime is source-visible; allocator behavior, peak memory and any out-of-memory consequence were not measured.

introductions.rationale: The new Transformers loop omits deletion of log_probs before row cleanup and shifts the logits using out-of-place addition. The parent native loop deletes the reference and shifts in place.
